name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Trigger strip and panels with arrow key navigation.
docs: Bind with v-model and give each TabsTrigger and TabsContent a matching value. Arrow keys move within the strip, Home and End jump to the ends. activationMode automatic switches on arrow key, manual waits for Enter or Space. Panels stay mounted by default so form state survives a tab change.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TabsRoot } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type TabsProps = {
  orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'
  /** 'automatic' follows arrow keys; 'manual' waits for Enter or Space. */
  activationMode?: 'automatic' | 'manual'
  /** Unmounts inactive panels instead of hiding them. */
  unmountOnHide?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<TabsProps>(), {
  orientation: 'horizontal',
  activationMode: 'automatic',
  unmountOnHide: false,
})

const model = defineModel<string | number>()
</script>

<template>
  <TabsRoot
    v-model="model"
    v-bind="$attrs"
    :orientation="orientation"
    :activation-mode="activationMode"
    :unmount-on-hide="unmountOnHide"
  >
    <slot />
  </TabsRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { TabsIndicator, TabsList } from 'reka-ui'
import { tabIndicator, tabList } from './styles'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type TabsListProps = {
  /** Wraps focus from the last trigger to the first. */
  loop?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<TabsListProps>(), {
  loop: true,
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})

const ready = ref(false)
let frameId: number | undefined

onMounted(async () => {
  // Wait one frame after TabsIndicator measures the initial active tab so the
  // indicator never slides in from x=0 on first paint.
  await nextTick()
  frameId = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    ready.value = true
  })
})

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  if (frameId !== undefined) window.cancelAnimationFrame(frameId)
})
</script>

<template>
  <TabsList
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :loop="loop"
    :data-ready="ready ? '' : undefined"
    :class="cn(tabList, attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <TabsIndicator :class="tabIndicator" />
    <slot />
  </TabsList>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { TabsTrigger } from 'reka-ui'
import { tabTrigger } from './styles'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type TabsTriggerProps = {
  value: string | number
  disabled?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<TabsTriggerProps>(), {
  disabled: false,
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <TabsTrigger
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :value="value"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :class="cn(tabTrigger, attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <slot />
  </TabsTrigger>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { TabsContent } from 'reka-ui'
import { tabPanel } from './styles'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type TabsContentProps = {
  value: string | number
  forceMount?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<TabsContentProps>(), {
  forceMount: false,
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <TabsContent
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :value="value"
    :force-mount="forceMount"
    :class="cn(tabPanel, attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <slot />
  </TabsContent>
</template>

/**
 * The trigger strip is a control-height track: 4px inset, 10px item radius, and a
 * raised pill indicator that glides smoothly between active triggers.
 */
export const tabList = [
  'group/tablist relative inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-control bg-control p-1',
  'data-[orientation=vertical]:flex-col data-[orientation=vertical]:items-stretch',
].join(' ')

export const tabIndicator = [
  'pointer-events-none absolute left-0 top-1 z-0 rounded-[10px] bg-raised shadow-sm',
  'h-[var(--reka-tabs-indicator-thickness)] w-[var(--reka-tabs-indicator-size)] translate-x-[var(--reka-tabs-indicator-position)]',
  'group-data-[orientation=vertical]/tablist:left-1 group-data-[orientation=vertical]/tablist:top-0',
  'group-data-[orientation=vertical]/tablist:h-[var(--reka-tabs-indicator-size)] group-data-[orientation=vertical]/tablist:w-[var(--reka-tabs-indicator-thickness)]',
  'group-data-[orientation=vertical]/tablist:translate-x-0 group-data-[orientation=vertical]/tablist:translate-y-[var(--reka-tabs-indicator-position)]',
  'group-data-[ready]/tablist:transition-[translate,width,height] group-data-[ready]/tablist:duration-[var(--p0seid0n-duration-slow)] group-data-[ready]/tablist:ease-spring motion-reduce:transition-none',
].join(' ')

export const tabTrigger = [
  'relative z-10 inline-flex h-8 items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-[10px] px-3',
  'text-[13px] font-medium text-ink-muted',
  'hover:text-ink',
  'data-[state=active]:bg-raised data-[state=active]:text-ink data-[state=active]:shadow-sm',
  'group-data-[ready]/tablist:data-[state=active]:bg-transparent group-data-[ready]/tablist:data-[state=active]:shadow-none',
  'outline-none focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ink',
  'transition-[background-color,color,box-shadow] duration-[var(--p0seid0n-duration-normal)] ease-out-expo motion-reduce:transition-none',
  'disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-55',
].join(' ')

export const tabPanel =
  'mt-4 text-[14px] text-ink-muted outline-none data-[state=active]:motion-safe:animate-panel-in'

export { default as Tabs } from './Tabs.vue'
export { default as TabsList } from './TabsList.vue'
export { default as TabsTrigger } from './TabsTrigger.vue'
export { default as TabsContent } from './TabsContent.vue'

export type { TabsProps } from './Tabs.vue'
export type { TabsListProps } from './TabsList.vue'
export type { TabsTriggerProps } from './TabsTrigger.vue'
export type { TabsContentProps } from './TabsContent.vue'
